verdict.rationale: Beamer documents its own feedback collection and prioritization, a public roadmap, and no-code setup, so a product manager can plausibly stand up public-facing feedback surfaces without engineers. However, no evidence explicitly describes a standalone public feedback portal or how one is configured. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a public feedback portal (idea submission, voting, hosted URL), portal setup or customization steps, and independent hands-on corroboration of no-code portal setup.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can set up a public-facing feedback portal without engineering help

citations.quote: Now, you can easily collect and prioritize feedback—and know how to build more value into your product.
You don’t need to know how to code to use Beamer.
Collect user comments and reactions to see what people really think of your latest product updates.
